title: Switchcraft recipe request
description: What a person asked for, as recipes: 'When [who] [how] the [switch], the [device] will [job].' Written by a person, a parser or a language model; checked, shown back as sentences, then compiled to a band by recipe.js. Never compiled straight to a rule table. See docs/recipe-schema.md.

mode.description: 'add': merge into the open band (new musicians and devices are added; a named musician or device id that already exists is updated). 'new-band': start from a blank band.

band.description: Settings for the whole band. Leave out to keep the band's current ones.

musicians.description: Who is playing. Every 'who' in devices must be listed here or already be in the band. Access settings are per musician, as on the How cards.

devices.description: The devices the recipes use. Recipes that share a device id share one device (for example 'next note' and 'back to the start' on one tune).

recipes.description: One entry per sentence: one switch doing one job on one device.

unmapped.description: Parts of the request no recipe can express. These go to the wish pile, not into the band.

text.description: The words from the request, as close to the original as possible.

reason.description: Why it can't be built yet, in plain words.

questions.description: Things to ask before building, when the request is ambiguous. Leave a slot null rather than guess, and ask here.

recipe.description: Index into recipes that the question is about, or null for the whole request.

name.description: Use initials or a first name only.

ignoreRepeatPressesMs.description: Presses this soon after the last one are ignored. For switches that get pressed twice by accident.

countsAsHeldMs.description: How long a press must last before it counts as holding.

drum.description: General MIDI drum sounds (channel 10 in a DAW).

sound.description: What a wobble or swell changes. 'brightness' = CC 74, 'vibrato' = CC 1, 'volume' = CC 7, 'pitch' = pitch bend, 'pressure' = channel pressure.

id.description: A short label, e.g. 'sam-drums'. Only used to link recipes to this device.

settings.description: Optional. Anything left out keeps the editor's defaults. Each field says which kinds it applies to.

tune.description: sequencer: the notes, as scale steps from the key's root (0 = root, 7 = an octave up in a 7-note scale; negative goes down), or null for a rest. Or a named tune.

beat.description: sequencer playing by itself: a drum pattern, one entry per step, null = rest.

euclid.description: sequencer playing by itself: spread 'hits' evenly over 'steps' (a Euclidean rhythm).

chord.description: arpeggiator: a chord of the key, or its notes as scale steps.

shape.description: wobble: sine, triangle, saw, square, random.

staysWhileHeld.description: swell: true = stays up while the switch is held, then falls; false = rises and falls once.

onEveryNoteOf.description: swell: the id of a sequencer or arpeggiator; the swell runs on each of its notes.

onMusician.description: wobble, swell: change another musician's sound instead of this musician's own.

note.description: notes devices only: which note this switch plays. A scale step, a MIDI note number, or a drum.

device.description: The id of an entry in devices.

job.description: What the device does. Which jobs a kind has: notes: play-note. sequencer: next-note, back-to-start (one note per press) or play, back-to-start (by itself). arpeggiator: play. wobble: wobble, stop. swell: swell. controls: octave-down, octave-up, semitone-down, semitone-up, next-template.

switch.description: Switch input 1-10, the left or right button on the box, or null if not said (the editor then asks the person to press the switch: Learn).

how.description: How the switch is pressed. Only play-note, play, wobble and swell use it; null for other jobs, or when not said (the device's default is used).
